description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired, STAGED). Generalized CLASS of the vultisig M-03 miss: a contract enforces a per-user cap (maxCapPerUser / per-user purchase or deposit limit) where the user's accumulated amount is keyed on ownership of a TRANSFERABLE position token (ERC721). Because the position NFT can be transferred away (balanceOf -> 0), a user resets the cap and re-buys, bypassing the per-user invariant. Two-signal: S1 a per-user cap term used in a check; S2 position identity derived from transferable-NFT ownership (balanceOf()/tokenOfOwnerByIndex()) in an ERC721 contract that does NOT block transfers (not soulbound). Suppress: views; soulbound/non-transferable token contracts; non-ERC721 contracts. Anchor: vultisig ILOPool.buy (maxCapPerUser + balanceOf(recipient)==0 ? mint : tokenOfOwnerByIndex; ERC721 transferable). Does NOT detect Sybil/whitelist caps.

fp_controls.two_signal_required: S1 a per-user cap term in a check AND S2 position identity from transferable-NFT ownership (balanceOf/tokenOfOwnerByIndex).
fp_controls.soulbound_suppression: contracts that block transfers (soulbound / nonTransferable / transfer-revert) -> suppressed.
fp_controls.non_erc721_suppression: contracts that are not ERC721 -> suppressed.
